title: Amend D08 so docs match read-only commit history access
summary: Retry of job 20261010-225741-yvk0: its only major finding was that docs/decisions.md D08 (line 233, "agents lose `git log` of the real history. That is the point.") still contradicts the new read-only commit view. Audience is the verifier and later readers of the decision log. This retry is docs-only: amend D08, mark it "Amended by D155", and ensure D155 lists alternatives and tradeoffs.

defaults_applied.how: D155 and the D08 amendment cite the exact hidden-path rules and tests in the candidate.
Decision text is written for an outside reader, with alternatives and tradeoffs.
Criteria check the sentence is gone and the pointer exists via Grep, not just that a file changed.
Searches all docs for the same stale claim, not only D08.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261010-225741-yvk0 passed fmt, clippy and test and failed only on one unmet content criterion (D08), so I assume the producer starts from its candidate (code, tests, CHANGELOG, enforcement.md and the D155 hunk already present). The repository copy I read has no D155 and D08 line 233 is unchanged, so if the producer instead starts from base, it must also write D155 (the new decision) in docs/decisions.md; the criteria cover both cases.

Findings of 20261010-225741-yvk0: (major) D08 not amended: fixed by rewording line 233 and adding 'Amended by D155'. (minor) run/mod.rs and run_pin_tests.rs changed outside deliverables: no longer applies, they are kept as-is and excluded in out_of_scope as needed wiring. (nit) hashes taken from request text only: no longer applies, it is a documented limit in D155 and CHANGELOG and stays.

Other docs saying agents never see real history: Grep found D08 line 233 as the clear one; docs/design/athena-v0.md:87 and :449 refer to D08 and should be read and reworded only if they claim no history access. docs/enforcement.md and docs/design/*.md are touched only if such a sentence exists.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/decisions.md D08 Tradeoff line (around line 233) no longer says agents lose the real history; it says agents can read the commits a job names through a filtered read-only view and the rest of history stays hidden, and D08 contains 'Amended by D155' (as at 'Amended by D63 and D115'). Check with Grep for 'That is the point' and 'Amended by D155' in docs/decisions.md.

docs/decisions.md has a D155 entry that lists alternatives (no history access, full history access, generated file only) with the tradeoff of each, and states the request-text-only hash limit. Check by reading the entry.
Grep of docs/ for sentences saying agents never see or lose the real history finds none left unreworded or unmarked; a reader checking D08 can follow it to D155.
Only files under docs/ differ in this retry's diff versus the candidate; no file under crates/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows changes.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`; all still pass, showing the docs edit broke nothing (docs-lint or doc-reference tests included).

out_of_scope: Any change to the candidate's code: crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs, crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs are kept as the earlier job left them, not edited here
Extracting hashes from brief text as well as request text
Making full history available to every agent, or any git write access
Edits to athena.toml, defaults.toml, or workflows
Building the proposed decision-to-claim consistency check (a separate job)
departures: Docs-only retry with a precisely named sentence, so cheaper and likelier to pass than the reference; some risk if the producer starts from base without D155.
